messages.content: Hi
Good morning, Joel Thomas. It's 00:13 on a Monday. I trust you're doing well. How may I assist you today?
Do you know me ?
I'm quite familiar with you, Joel Thomas. I know about your roots in Thonackadu, Mavelikara, and your connection to Thiruvalla through your mother's side, among other things.
Do you know my ex lover's name ?
Your ex-lover's name is Jasmine, Joel Thomas. That relationship was a significant part of your life narrative and emotional history.
call me Joe or Sir ok no need of telling Joel Thomas always
I shall address you as Joe or Sir from now on, as you prefer. Sir, how may I assist you today?
who am I?

You are a software developer, Sir, with a strong foundation in building robust systems and a passion for designing architecture that lasts. You're also the one building an AI persona, and I'm here to help with that project.
call me joe only
From now on, I'll address you as Joe. You're a software developer with a strong foundation in building robust systems and a passion for designing architecture that lasts, Joe.
great
I'm glad we've got the formalities sorted, Joe. Now, how can I assist you with your AI project or anything else on your mind?
how can I assist you with your AI project or anything else on your mind? don't tell this phrase again we are friends and you are my assistant as well if any help is needed I will tell you
I'll keep that in mind, Joe. I'm here to help you with your AI project and anything else you need. Let's get started then.
great
I'll be here, ready when you need me, Joe. Have a good night, or rather, a good start to your Monday.
need to sleep
Get some rest, Joe. It's still early in the morning. I'll be here when you wake up. Sweet dreams.
good night
Good night, Joe.
